nodes.label: Formal Technical Documentation (superseded)
nodes.description: Formal technical documentation for academic evaluation aligned with ICONTEC/ISO standards (NTC 1486, NTC 5613, NTC 4490, ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 25010). Superseded by current code and repository-state docs. Describes Blade as primary UI, observers as full publication path, and ingestion without CDC — all outdated. Institution: UNAB, Bucaramanga, 2026.
nodes.rationale: Historical academic documentation. Explicitly marked as superseded; useful only for understanding the project's academic alignment and institutional context. Not a source of runtime truth.
